title: Battle of Kompoti
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Kompoti", at revision 1370267318, opens: "The Battle of Kompoti was a military engagement of the Greek War of Independence, with a victorious outcome for the Greeks." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q16331864, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1822". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
